summary.zh-CN: 全新安装无需 API Key 即可开始聊天，同时改进聊天输入、侧栏导航与消息显示体验。
summary.en-US: Fresh installations can start chatting without an API key, with improved chat input, sidebar navigation, and message rendering.

body.zh-CN: 全新安装默认启用 OpenCode Zen Free Trial 和 big-pickle，无需先填写 API Key。
body.en-US: Fresh installations enable OpenCode Zen Free Trial and big-pickle without requiring an API key first.

body.zh-CN: 模型选择器提供当前验证可用的七个免费试用模型，同时保留已有提供商配置。
body.en-US: The model selector includes seven currently verified free-trial models while preserving existing provider configuration.

body.zh-CN: 欢迎页和输入工具栏更简洁，技能、模型、图片附件与富文本操作反馈更加一致。
body.en-US: The welcome screen and input toolbar are simpler, with more consistent feedback for skills, models, image attachments, and rich text.

body.zh-CN: 时间、项目和其他页面之间切换时不再残留错误选中状态，添加项目操作也更容易识别。
body.en-US: Switching across time, project, and other views no longer leaves a stale selection, and adding a project is easier to recognize.

title.zh-CN: 活动预览跟随界面语言

body.zh-CN: 思考、工具调用、运行失败和意外中断预览会按当前界面语言显示。
body.en-US: Reasoning, tool-call, run-failure, and interruption previews now follow the interface language.

body.zh-CN: 并发消息完成时不再偶尔重叠或重复显示，静默回复也不会留下异常文本。
body.en-US: Concurrent messages no longer occasionally overlap or duplicate when they finish, and silent replies no longer leave stray text.

body.zh-CN: 输入框上方内容使用自然渐隐，全局完成通知在悬停时保持清晰不透明。
body.en-US: Content fades naturally above the composer, and global completion notifications remain fully opaque on hover.

body.zh-CN: 升级无需迁移已有配置；免费试用模型与额度可能变化，公共网关不适合敏感或机密信息。
body.en-US: Upgrading requires no configuration migration; free-trial models and quotas may change, and the public gateway is not intended for sensitive or confidential information.
